Immutable account envelope identity with monotonic observation time and same-observation budget conflict rejection
Exact 8-decimal money arithmetic across account, broker, portfolio, assignment, ticker, sector and correlation dimensions
Canonical quantity ceiling, no independent sizing or economic ranking
Sovereign-ordered batch admission with multiple affordable proposals allowed

Atomic composition API for reservation and intent binding

No timeout-based release of ambiguous, expired, missing-fill or unqualified native-package commitments
Inline storage budget, immutable audit events and protected reservation identity
